energy_note: Energy is ESTIMATED from Apple Silicon on-die CPU package power telemetry sampled by powermetrics and integrated over each timed window. It excludes DRAM, display and PSU losses, and is not a wall-socket measurement.

power_state.thermal_pressure: Note: No thermal warning level has been recorded | Note: No performance warning level has been recorded | Note: No CPU power status has been recorded

grid_intensity_source: world average grid carbon intensity, ~481 gCO2e/kWh; substitute your own grid's figure -- national values range from under 50 (hydro/nuclear-heavy) to over 700 (coal-heavy), and this constant scales every CO2e number reported here linearly
